name: sign_posts_timber
notes: Two squared oak posts 25 cm thick and 2.25 m tall, set 1.75 m apart so a 2.4 m name board nailed across their faces hides them at its ends; a village notice or a name board at the edge of a settlement. Broad face along local X, front at -Z. The board is drawn as plates (world/places.rs), not voxels, and never weathers, so the posts don't either.
